UPDATE rental_risk_flags
SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = now()
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND asset_id NOT IN (SELECT asset_id FROM v_rental_risk)
  AND set_config('app.actor', 'n8n:Phase3 - Rental Risk Detection', true) IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO rental_risk_flags ( asset_id, vendor_id, vendor_name, employee_id, employee_name, asset_status_at_detection, qty, status, detected_at, party_type ) SELECT r.asset_id, r.vendor_id, r.vendor_name, r.current_employee_id, r.employee_name, r.asset_status, r.qty, 'open', now(), r.party_type FROM v_rental_risk r WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rental_risk_flags f WHERE f.asset_id = r.asset_id AND f.status = 'open' ) AND set_config('app.actor', 'n8n:Phase3 - Rental Risk Detection', true) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    v.vendor_name,
    v.flagged,
    v.lost,
    t.total_open,
    t.new_today
FROM (
    SELECT vendor_name,
           count(*) AS flagged,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE asset_status_at_detection = 'lost') AS lost
    FROM rental_risk_flags
    WHERE status = 'open'
    GROUP BY vendor_name
) v
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS total_open,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at::date = current_date) AS new_today
    FROM rental_risk_flags
    WHERE status = 'open'
) t
ORDER BY v.flagged DESC;
